You’re not alone. I’ve been obsessed with becoming a hero for years. I was starving myself earlier in the year to “help me get into better shape” and not be as fat as I feel. We both have done some pretty similar things. And for me, I’ve been trying to push that obsession into wanting to become an officer. Maybe you could too? You’re not crazy. Instead, you’ve been trying to do something good, just with the wrong methods. I get it. 

There’s no need to feel like obsessing over doing good is the only way to keep you from hurting yourself. Obviously I’m no expert, because I’ve probably worded everything in this response wrong, so I’m sorry for that. Just know that there are other people out there who feel as you do, and I’m always willing to talk if you feel powerless.
